project_description: Formalize issue #431 as a post-PR-#428 brownfield hardening/certification effort. Preserve attemptSession.TerminalizeAttempt as the sole physical B-leg terminal owner while adding a linearizable A-leg launch/cancel barrier, concurrent cancellation fan-out, truthful physical CancelResult propagation, an additive negotiated backend-plugin active-Execute cancellation handshake with bounded per-attempt graceful-to-force fallback and legacy transport compatibility, and attempt-owned provider-sideband evidence preservation for exactly-once terminal B-leg billing. Preserve streaming/no-retry-after-output, B2BUA attempt sequence, secure-session, selector, frontend, billing-rating/journal, and provider/core boundaries. PR #428 is merged on main as 7a6c7532 and the final merged ready-owned cancellation/publication baseline has been revalidated; the spec is implementation-ready.
